hypothesis: Visible reference routes across the existing method, context, paper and text-summary modules may make project evidence easier to discover and cite after recrawling.

selection.definition: 100 * existing geo_eval site_cited cells / 60; bare project-domain occurrences also count under the frozen judge.
selection.validity: All 15 fixed queries and four engines must return valid responses before automatic ranking.
selection.inner_metric: not computed; not used for selection
selection.baseline: Reuse R7 live 60-cell measurement from 2026-10-16T12:00:17+00:00: 6/60, composite 29.4444.
selection.deployment: An unpublished tree is unmeasured. R8 production deployment requires explicit user approval.
selection.history: Preserve all historical candidates, including discard, with parent commits, module scope, and measurements.
selection.limitations: Cross-round observations are cumulative, not isolated module ablations; timing, indexing and tool failures differ. Do not rank combinations by adding old scores.

graph_edit_limit: Built-in geo-apply exposes support HTML as assets with no operations and omits llms.txt. Use explicit apply_patch in the allocated worktree and preserve full instance graph fingerprints; no scorer change.
